source_title: WPL 2027 DC full squad: Delhi Capitals players bought, full team list, retained stars and latest signings - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Delhi Capitals have completed their squad for the Women's Premier League (WPL) 2027, with 17 players secured following the auction in Kochi. The franchise added four players at the auction, including Indian batter Kiran Navgire, all-rounders Kashvi Kandikuppa and Nazma Khan, and Scotland spinner Kirstie Gordon.Delhi Capitals spent Rs 1.05 crore at the auction, taking their total expenditure to Rs 14.95 crore, including Rs 13.9 crore spent on retentions. With Rs 5 lakh remaining in their purse, the franchise have 11 Indian players and six overseas players in their squad.Delhi Capitals purse and squad detailsRetention spend: Rs 13.9 croreAuction spend: Rs 1.05 croreTotal spend: Rs 14.95 crorePurse remaining: Rs 5 lakhTotal players: 17Indian players: 11Overseas players: 6Delhi Capitals retained playersDelhi Capitals retained Jemimah Rodrigues (Rs 2.2 crore), Shafali Verma (Rs 2.2 crore), Marizanne Kapp (Rs 2.2 crore), Annabel Sutherland (Rs 2.2 crore), Chinelle Henry (Rs 1.3 crore), Shree Charani (Rs 1.3 crore), Laura Wolvaardt (Rs 1.1 crore), Niki Prasad (Rs 50 lakh), Minnu Mani (Rs 40 lakh), Nandani Sharma (Rs 20 lakh), Deeya Yadav (Rs 10 lakh), Mamatha Madiwala (Rs 10 lakh) and Lucy Hamilton (Rs 10 lakh).Delhi Capitals players bought at WPL 2027 auctionDelhi Capitals signed Kiran Navgire for Rs 75 lakh, while Kashvi Kandikuppa, Nazma Khan and Kirstie Gordon were acquired for Rs 10 lakh each.
